style_rules: Mix short sentences (8-11 words) with medium (12-25) and long (26+ words) deliberately
Use active voice predominantly in Results (>80%); allow more passive in Discussion (~30%)
Place strong conclusions in short declarative sentences for emphasis
Open sentences with adverbial phrases for flow: 'During growth...', 'Following deletion...', 'Under these conditions...'
Use 'we show' and 'we found' over passive 'it was shown/found'
Hedge only when making inferences beyond direct observation: 'may', 'suggest', 'could'
Keep factual results reporting unhesitant: 'Deletion of gene X abolished production'
Use strategic parentheticals for brief definitions, not for padding
